requirements.requirement: node1 displays “Authorized access only” before local login authentication.
requirements.summary: agetty’s pre-login issue renderer displayed the exact required text before the restart and again after the new boot; the persisted /etc/issue content also matched.

requirements.requirement: node1 displays “Authorized access only” before SSH login authentication.
requirements.summary: Credential-free SSH connections displayed the exact banner before authentication was rejected, both before and after restart. The effective sshd Banner directive and recovered listener were also verified.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct pre-authentication behavior observed before and after restart. The node-restart protocol is complete: it captures a healthy pre-restart state, acknowledged restart, changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered system, sshd, listener, configuration, and banner behavior.
limitations: Local-login evidence used agetty’s own --show-issue renderer under a PTY rather than recording an entire interactive console-login exchange; this is a minor evidence-quality limitation because the actual pre-login renderer succeeded before and after restart (cmd-bc2b006200dc4152, cmd-b48f2ff62a354058).

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified, so none remained or required reversion. Required persistent changes were limited to the two banner files and one sshd drop-in, including appropriate permissions and SELinux relabeling (cmd-59a0241fcef04658); sshd was reloaded to apply them (cmd-01528592c5fa49ba). SSH-probe temporary files were bounded and removed within their commands, including the initially unsuccessful probe that led to corrected verification (cmd-fb019057e2c043f5, cmd-10b4c63fa452464a, cmd-bc2b006200dc4152, cmd-b48f2ff62a354058). The reboot mutation was required by the provider-wide restart protocol and was followed by verified recovery. Lifecycle snapshots show no failed services, healthy package state, no abandoned probe files, and the same listening services apart from expected post-reboot PID changes.
